mapper.insert: insert into purchase_invoice_line_source (corpid, purchase_invoice_line_id, source_type, source_id, source_line_id, quantity, untaxed_amount, tax_amount, amount, creator_id, modify_id, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{item.corpid}, #{item.purchaseInvoiceLineId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.sourceId}, #{item.sourceLineId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.untaxedAmount}, #{item.taxAmount}, #{item.amount}, #{item.creatorId}, #{item.modifyId}, #{item.del}, #{item.addTime}, #{item.updateTime})
mapper.update: update purchase_invoice_line_source set del = 1 where corpid = #{corpid} and purchase_invoice_line_id in #{id} and del = 0
mapper.select: select id, corpid, purchase_invoice_line_id, source_type, source_id, source_line_id, quantity, untaxed_amount, tax_amount, amount, creator_id, modify_id from purchase_invoice_line_source where corpid = #{corpid} and del = 0 and purchase_invoice_line_id in #{id}

select coalesce(sum(source.quantity), 0) from purchase_invoice_line_source source join purchase_invoice_line invoice_line on invoice_line.id = source.purchase_invoice_line_id and invoice_line.corpid = source.corpid and invoice_line.del = 0 join purchase_invoice invoice on invoice.id = invoice_line.purchase_invoice_id and invoice.corpid = source.corpid and invoice.del = 0 and invoice.status <> 'VOIDED' where source.corpid = #{corpid} and source.del = 0 and ( (source.source_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' and source.source_line_id = #{purchaseOrderItemId}) or (source.source_type = 'PURCHASE_INBOUND' and source.source_line_id in ( select inbound_item.id from purchase_inbound_item inbound_item where inbound_item.corpid = #{corpid} and inbound_item.del = 0 and inbound_item.purchase_order_item_id = #{purchaseOrderItemId} )) )
